reason: Replace the terminal recommendation with an existing verified Web command, session and plugin-settings search utility. DSH TUI remains in the same 100 recipes. Scores, identities, packages, sources, setup and individual lifecycle evidence are unchanged.

sourceReview.appearanceBoundary: No skin, palette, wallpaper or global layout implementation. Generic action discovery may navigate to existing host controls.
